pipeline.modality: ARTEMIS T-cell receptor platform (CD19-directed engineered T-cell therapy; differs from CAR-T by using TCR-like signaling)

indications.trial_design: Phase 1 dose escalation + Phase 2 dose expansion; open-label
indications.trial_status: RECRUITING — Phase 1 dose-escalation completed Dec 2025 (n=9, no treatment-related SAEs, 100% CR in high-dose cohort at Month 1); DSMB recommended advancing to Phase 2 expansion at RP2D (presented Feb 2026 ASTCT/CIBMTR Tandem Meetings)

excluded_preclinical.reason: ARTEMIS T-cell therapy targeting both CD19 and CD22; no active P1/P2/P3 trial registered — preclinical stage
